characters.name: Gavin
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname: His mum calls him "my little prince", Stacey calls him "Gav" and Smithy calls him "Gavlar". Childhood Friends: He and Smithy have been best friends since they were 7 years old. Deadpan Snarker: Especially in response to Smithy's more ridiculous antics. Heterosexual Life-Partners: With Smithy. Like Father, Like Son: Both he and Mick are theOnly Sane Manof their respective units.

characters.name: Mick
characters.description: Deadpan Snarker: Responds to most of Pam's melodramas with dry wit. Happily Married: In contrast to Pete and Dawn, he has a loving relationship with his wife (even if he gets exasperated at her histrionics occasionally). Like Father, Like Son: He and Gavin are very alike. Only Sane Man: Acts as this for the Essex-based characters, even taking this role to the otherwise-grounded Gavin on occasion. Parental Substitute: He and Pam are like surrogate parents to Smithy. It is Mick's opinion that Smithy's most wants in the series finale over whether or not to go through with his wedding toSonia.

characters.name: Pam
characters.description: Catchphrase: "Mick! MICHAEL!", "Oh my Christ!" Delusions of Eloquence: She butchers common expressions or misuses words when trying to appear more articulate than she actually is.Pam: Ours is not to question while. Department of Redundancy Department: Occasionally has her moments:"Your only son has emigrated abroad to another country..." Dumb Blonde: She's considered very attractive for her age, but she's pretty dim and prone to drastically misunderstanding things. Embarrassing Nickname: Calls her son Gavin "my little prince."

characters.name: Harri, Caitlin, and Megan
characters.description: Family Theme Naming: Quite a subtle one, but their names are very similar to three members of the British royal family: Prince Harry, Catherine "Kate" Middleton, and Meghan Markle. Satellite Family Member: They don't get much characterisation and are barely seen at all in the 2024 special.

characters.name: Stacey
characters.description: Cleavage Window: Stacey is fond of these, wearing them on multiple episodes. Covert Pervert: She acts sweet and innocent, but she'sveryopen about how often she masturbates, much to the shock of Gavin, Smithy and Dan. She also doesn't think twice about showing her knickers to Smithy when he's lingerie shopping for his girlfriend. Department of Redundancy Department: HerVerbal Tic, like when she tells Gavin she's going to do something "now, in a minute!" Disposable Fiancé: Has been engagedfivetimes. But only in love once, with Gavin. Dude Magnet: She's been engaged five different times!

characters.name: Bryn
characters.description: Ambiguously Gay: Bryn certainly shows a lot more interest in men than women, but it's never confirmed as he's entirely chaste and implied to be a virgin. Given that he's unfazed by other people's homosexuality, it seems not so much that he's in denial as that the thought he is gay has just somehow never occurred to him.Rob Brydonhas stated that he thinks that Bryn is gay. Can't Hold His Liquor: A couple of pints has him weeping and retching on the kerb outside the club. Catchphrase: "I won't lie to you", "I'll tell you for why..." Comedic Sociopath: Wanders into this territory in the 2024 Special when he learns of Gwen and Dave's relationship, and starts to aggressively press the latter to tell them all about thefishing trip... that he himself was a part of. Easily Impressed: He takes delight in the most mundane of things, such as power showers and printing driving directions off the internet.

characters.name: Gwen
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: Probably the sweetest person on the show, but she won't hesitate to snap if Pam takes her anti-Welsh sentiment a bit too far...or ifJean shows up to her party. Covert Pervert: Like Stacey, she seems sweet but apparently has quite a kinky side. During Gavin and Stacey's wedding, she jumps into a conversation between Pam and Dawn about the latter's rocky marriage and suggests they try roleplaying, saying it did wonders for her relationship with Stacey's dad. Extreme Doormat: Has shades of this, particularly during the final episode, where she offers no response to Nessa's constant unnecessary rudeness towards her. Intergenerational Friendship: With Doris, who comes over to the house regularly and seems to see Gwen as a surrogate daughter. Parental Substitute: To Nessa, who tells Gwen on her wedding day she considers her a mother figure.

characters.name: Jason
characters.description: But Not Too Gay: His boyfriend Jose is barely seen, only appearing at Gavin and Stacey's wedding. Noodle Incident: The fishing trip; all we know is that it wascold, but whatever he and Bryn didit was perfectly legal in their country. Only Sane Man: For the Barry-based characters. Jason isn't particularly quirky and usually the voice of reason when he's around. In the finale,he's even the one who points out they could have just rang Nessa instead of driving from Essex to Southampton on a bus. Straight Gay: He doesn't have any stereotypicalCamp Gaytraits.

characters.name: Smithy
characters.description: Anguished Declaration of Love: ToNessain the series finale.Nessa says yes. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Nessa, since they do not like each other at all to start with, but it doesn't stop them from having sex occasionally and they even begin to bond over food and the baby. Berserk Button: People asking him to share his food. Big Brother Bully: He's prone to getting into physical scraps with his sister and tells her she's not allowed to call herself Smithy. Despite that they're clearly very close. Big Eater: His takeaway orders usually involve multiple dishes and are generally sizeable enough to feed an entire family at once.

characters.name: Rudi
characters.description: The Gadfly: She can't resist taking cracks at Smithy, especially about his weight. The Lad-ette: She's quite loud and brash as well as wearing boyish clothes andHeelys. Only Known by Their Nickname: Smithy won't let her go by "Smithy" around his friends, but no one ever calls her "Ruth". Twin Telepathy: Smithy and Rudi aren't twins, but their minds work on an almost creepily similar wavelength. Unfortunate Names: In the finale she has four children named Brighton, Taplow, Chingford and...Aldi.

characters.name: Cath
characters.description: The Alcoholic: She claims to have narcolepsy but Pam suggests this is the real reason for her constant nodding off. Ambiguously Gay: There's a rumour she had an affair with the headmistress of Gavin and Smithy's primary school, but it's never confirmed either way. Parental Neglect: She's not very engaged with either Smithy or Rudi and seems too tired to deal with them most of the time.

characters.name: Dawn
characters.description: Awful Wedded Life: She and her husband Pete are constantly at each other's throats. Best Friend: She and Pam are inseparable and Dawn even tells Pam during a big argument with the West family that if she wants to fight Nessa, she'll back her up. Clingy Jealous Girl:When she and Pete finally get divorced, she ends up stalking him and then practically bullies him out of his new relationship after they drunkenly sleep together. Slap-Slap-Kiss: With Pete. Statuesque Stunner: She's 5'9" tall and takes pride in her appearance.

characters.name: Pete
characters.description: Awful Wedded Life: Pete and his wife Dawn are constantly at each other's throats. Exiled to the Couch: It's mentioned that Pete often sleeps in the shed when he and Dawn are fighting. Impossibly Tacky Clothes: The ridiculously flashy ring Pete buys for the vow renewal ceremony. Slap-Slap-Kiss: With Dawn. Ugly Guy, Hot Wife: While not exactlyugly, he is balding and shorter and stockier than his comparatively glamorous wife.

characters.name: Nessa
characters.description: Almighty Janitor: If her many stories about her past jobs are to be believed. Beauty Inversion: Look for a clip of Ruth Jones when she'snotplaying Nessa, and then quietly marvel at how much effort must have gone into making her look that rough. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Smithy - they can't stand each other initially, but they start to grow closer over the course of the series, especially after Nessa gets pregnant and they bond over food. Bouncer: Had this job as part of herMysterious Past. The Comically Serious: Even while telling the most ridiculous story, she's able to do it with a serious tone.

characters.name: Neil the Baby
characters.description: "All Grown Up" Remark: In the series finale, with Smithy telling Nessa what an amazing job she's done raising Neil. Nessa tells Smithy she didn't do it alone and he's been a great dad. Beautiful Singing Voice: He sings and plays the guitar on a cover ofThe Beatles' "Blackbird" in the finale. Like Father, Like Son: He joins his dad's construction firm as an apprentice. Phrase Catcher: "Neil, the baby." Role Reprise: Oscar Hartland played infant Neil in series 3 in 2009, and returned in 2019 and 2024.

characters.name: Doris
characters.description: Berserk Button: Don't ask her to do the salad. Dirty Old Woman: She hits on Gavin and isn't shy about sharing the details of her relationships with much younger men. Silver Vixen: Doris (whose actress was around 80 during filming) seems to have no trouble picking up younger men...''much'' younger men. The Character Died With Her: Margaret John passed away in the years between the filming of the programme's third series and the 2019 Christmas special. The latter confirms that Doris also passed away on Christmas Eve some years prior, with the rest of the main cast taking a moment to remember and raise a glass to her memory.

characters.name: Dave Coaches
characters.description: Ascended Extra: Originally a minor character, he comes into the fold in later series. Doting Parent: He is a doting almost-stepfather to Neil the Baby when he's an infant, and it's clear that he cares for him deeply. Iconic Item: He's almost always seen wearing a bolo tie. Knowledge Broker: The only person apart from Bryn and Jason who knows what happened onthe fishing trip. He attempts to divulge the information in 2024 but isinterruptedby Gwen's omelette burning. Second Love: Plays this role toGwenin the finale.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.description: The Ghost: Lucy is frequently mentioned but never seen as she'salways busy doing some kind of extracurricular activityassociated with younger people (e.g. Guides or a netball tournament).

characters.name: Sonia
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She presents herself as sweet and bubbly, but threatens to make Smithy's life hell if she doesn't get exactly what she wants. Bridezilla:She insists on controlling every aspect of her hen party and wedding and gets very angry when things don't go exactly to plan. Fish Out of Water: When Smithy brings her to Christmas lunch in the 2019 special, she's aNaïve Newcomerwho doesn't really fit in with his friends. Things get awkward when she asks them to explain their in-jokes and wants to know why Nessa has given everyone taps. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Subverted - she's blonde and seems sweet at first, but is actually kind of a horrible person. Hate Sink: Sonia is introduced with little to no redeeming qualities. She's dismissive of Smithy's friends, clearly has little in common with him and is extremely controlling, even saying to him that he's punching above his weight with her. By the end,every single one of Smithy's friends and familyand even some of her ownthink Smithy should leave her.
